files.name: 空面板
refs: D:\Desktop\细胞绘制\主界面\按钮_v1\03_设置_v1.png
files.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: ONE standalone EMPTY PAUSE MENU PANEL for the Chinese cartoon pixel-art biological tower-defense game 胞卫战.
Input image is the style and border edit target: transform the small cream menu button into a LARGE near-square vertical pause panel, while preserving its stepped pixel corners, dark plum outline, cream-white highlights and restrained salmon lower bevel.
Layout: portrait 4:5 transparent canvas, one centered panel occupying about 84% width and 84% height, fully visible with transparent margin on all sides. Front view with no perspective.
Panel design: a moderately thick cream-white cell-membrane-inspired frame, dark plum outer silhouette, subtle coral lower rim, a very narrow immune-cyan inner edge as an accent. The entire large interior is a calm uniform pale peach-cream field, EMPTY and uncluttered. The interior must have ample room for three wide buttons stacked vertically later in Unity. No baked-in slots or button shapes. No title tab.
Style: same simple cheerful retro pixel-game UI as the reference; crisp square pixel clusters, regular stepped outlines, restrained 3-tone flat shading. Reduce texture. No glossy 3D, blur, realistic flesh or smooth painted detail.
Text: NONE. Remove the original 设置 text completely. No letters, numbers, header, pause bars, logos, icons, cells, characters, gears, X/close button or decoration in the center.
Background: genuinely transparent outside the panel; the panel interior is opaque. Preserve alpha transparency, no backdrop, no drawn checkerboard, no cast shadow beyond a tiny attached pixel bevel.
Exactly one empty panel; no other components, no collage, no examples of a completed menu.

files.name: 设置
refs: D:\Desktop\细胞绘制\暂停菜单_v1\06_设置_未选中.png
files.prompt:
Use case: text-localization.
Task: Correct the malformed Chinese lettering in this settings button. Input image is the EDIT TARGET. The two characters must read EXACTLY “设置” in correct standard Simplified Chinese, using a conventional upright bold Chinese sans-serif / 黑体 typeface, not experimental pixel lettering.
Only replace the two text glyphs. Preserve the existing transparent 2172x724 canvas, button outer silhouette, border, bevel, all colors, placement and margins exactly. Do not redesign or widen the button.
Correct glyph anatomy is the main goal:
“设” uses the LEFT radical “讠” (two strokes: the top dot AND the complete lower horizontal-turn-down-up stroke; do not omit either). Its RIGHT component is “殳”, with the top 几-like shape and complete 又 beneath. It is 设, NOT 没, 投, 役, or an invented symbol.
“置” uses a fully closed flat “罒” across the top, with two short internal verticals, and a complete “直” below; preserve every horizontal line and the bottom stroke. No missing, broken, melted or overlapping strokes.
Render both characters as clear typeset Simplified Chinese HeiTi / Noto Sans CJK SC Heavy glyphs with comfortable spacing, equal cap height and a common baseline. Keep the text centered with generous side margins. Prefer Chinese glyph accuracy over chunky pixel stylization. No handwriting, calligraphy, decorative stroke cuts or faux glyphs.
Unselected cream state: correct letters filled solid dark-indigo, with no additional outline or colored interior. Keep the existing cream body untouched.
Exactly one button with exactly the label “设置”. No extra text, no icons, no watermark. Outside remains genuinely transparent, no checkerboard, no colored background.
